hooks.name: Re-verify specimens
hooks.description: When a specimen or a codemod/test-generation file changes, re-run the real before/after verification so the lab never shows stale evidence.

action.prompt: Run `npm run necro:verify` (optionally only for the changed preset id). Report the before/after line for each specimen. If any resurrected tree is not fully green (install, tests, lint, build), investigate the failing case in data/presets/<id>.json, fix the engine, and re-run. Never edit data/presets/*.json by hand.
